subject: Phased autoscale plan + burst top-up request for BlueQuarry renewal
messages:
From: Nina Patel <nina@bluequarry.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Aakash Rao <aakash.rao@bluequarry.ai>, procurement@bluequarry.ai
Date: 2026-05-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Q1 usage + renewal conversation

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the check-in last week. We pulled Q1 telemetry and wanted to share a quick summary: 35% higher peak token throughput in late April driven by a new feature rollout, and steady state utilization is ~72% on our dedicated pool (A100s). We expect another product launch in July that could nudge peaks toward 50% above current.

Two asks before renewal:
- Can Redwood provision a short-term burst top-up to handle July peaks (2–3 weeks)?
- For the renewal, we’re open to resizing committed capacity but prefer a phased approach rather than one large tranche.

Attached: bluequarry_usage_report_Q1.csv

Looking for cost/ops options and a proposed timeline.

—Nina
Head of Platform, BlueQuarry
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina@bluequarry.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-22T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q1 usage + renewal conversation

Nina —

Appreciate the export. High-level response here and I’ll pull in ops/finance for numbers:

Summary of options we recommend:
1) Short-term burst: immediate burst credit allocation (non-reserved) up to +30% for 21 days — fast to enable, billed on usage.
2) Phased reserved top-up: 2-stage commit — +20% reserved capacity for 90 days (can convert to longer term) then evaluate telemetry and either convert additional capacity or keep burst.
3) Model-level mitigation: quantization and KV caching recommendations that could reduce token cost by ~10–18% for the workloads you described.

Next steps: Ben, can you run a pricing sketch for (A) burst credit costs for 21 days and (B) a 6-month staggered commit (20% then +10% conditional)? Karthik — ops playbook for enabling burst quickly and the canary rollout plan.

Nina — I’ll aim to get a concrete SOW draft and cost sketch by next Tuesday.

Thanks,
Mina
Senior AC, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-25T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Q1 usage + renewal conversation

Team —

Pricing sketch attached in-line: (summary)
- Burst credit: estimated $18k–$26k for 21 days at current peak throughput (A100-equivalent). This is usage-based; we can cap exposure per day.
- Phased reserved: baseline +20% reserved (6-month commitment) ~ $45k/mo discounted; option to add +10% after 90 days at pre-agreed rate.
- If they convert burst to reserved within 30 days of start, we can credit 30% of burst spend toward first invoice.

Kimberly — will need procurement language for the crediting clause and a short amendment for the renewal SOW.

Ben
Sr. Deals Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: proposed_topup_SOW.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Nina Patel <nina@bluequarry.ai>
Date: 2026-06-15T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q1 usage + renewal conversation

On Tue, May 25, 2026 at 08:30, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Pricing sketch attached in-line: (summary)
> - Burst credit: estimated $18k–$26k for 21 days at current peak throughput (A100-equivalent).

Nina / BlueQuarry — ops notes and timeline below: 
- We can enable burst credits within 48 hours after amendment signature. Burst will attach to your existing dedicated pool and scale transparently.
- Canary plan: route 10% of production traffic to burst instances for first 24 hours, expand to 50% next 48 hours, then to full if metrics stable.
- Capacity suggestion: enable burst equivalent of +200 A100 token-hrs (approx. 8 x A100 for 3 weeks).
- Monitoring: we’ll expose per-route token metrics and set auto-fallback to hosted smaller models if latency or error rate exceeds thresholds.

Operational ask: Please confirm blackout windows for July launch (if any) and any preferred maintenance windows so we can schedule canary safely.

—Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Nina Patel <nina@bluequarry.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aakash Rao <aakash.rao@bluequarry.ai>, procurement@bluequarry.ai
Date: 2026-06-16T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q1 usage + renewal conversation

All —

Thanks. We need burst enabled on July 6 through July 26 for an expected campaign. No blackout windows. The conversion-credit sounds good; procurement would like the credit in writing in the SOW plus a 30-day notice for conversion.

Two clarifications:
1) If we convert burst spend to reserved, is the credit applied to the first invoice only or spread over the first 3 invoices?
2) Can the canary traffic be limited to one region (us-west) — we want to avoid cross-region routing for the campaign.

If you can get the SOW and amendment language this week, procurement can fast-track.

—Nina
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina@bluequarry.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-30T16:44:00-07:00
Subject: Final SOW & next steps — BlueQuarry burst + phased top-up

Nina / BlueQuarry team —

Attached is the proposed_topup_SOW.pdf and the short amendment language we’ll add to the renewal:
- Burst: enable +200 A100-equivalent burst capacity (approx. 8 x A100 for 21 days) July 6–26. Cap daily charge at $1,100/day; estimated range $18k–$23k.
- Phased reserved amendment: +20% reserved capacity on renewal for first 90 days. Option to add +10% within 30 days of conversion at the originally agreed rate.
- Crediting: if BlueQuarry converts burst spend into reserved commitment within 30 days of burst start, Redwood will apply 30% of burst spend as a one-time credit to the first invoice. (procurement requested language: credit applied to first invoice — this matches their ask)
- Region: canary and burst pegged to us-west only.

Action items:
- BlueQuarry: sign SOW/Amendment via DocuSign (link included).
- Kimberly / Legal: draft the short amendment clause and ticket the SOW into billing system.
- Ben: prepare final invoice template and mark the burst cap.
- Karthik / Ops: schedule the canary runbook for July 6 and confirm monitoring hooks.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/BQ-2026-042-SOW
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1BlueQuarry-Runway
